name: dogfood-payment-embedded-finance-app
description: Dogfood app v1.41-2 — a Stripe Treasury + Unit + Column style embedded finance orchestrator (BaaS account open + funding transfers + card issuance both virtual + physical + KYC individual verification + KYB business verification with score thresholds) that drives a payments-as-a-platform surface backed by @kiwa-test/payment v0.5 embedded-finance semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_STRIPE_TREASURY_KEY + KIWA_UNIT_API_URL + KIWA_COLUMN_API_URL provider endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/payment -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
